bull_bear.body:
- Our business is substantially dependent on revenues from the manufacturing of tarpaulin and the trading of granules, and any inability to retain existing customers or attract new customers for these products may adversely affect our business.
- Our company is engaged in the manufacturing of tarpaulins and related products.
- Additionally, we are involved in the sale of granules, which are used as raw materials in the production of tarpaulins.
- While the majority of our operational revenue has historically been derived from manufacturing activities, a notable portion of revenue during the financial year was generated from granule sales.
- Reliance on a limited range of products exposes us to substantial risk in the event of adverse changes in market dynamics, including but not limited to shifts in customer preferences or reduced demand.
- Such dependency renders our revenue stream susceptible to volatility and market disruptions.
- Furthermore, any failure or inability to secure new clientele for these products may adversely affect the Company’s business operations, financial condition, and results of operations.
- These arrangements enable us to procure granules at competitive prices, a portion of which is utilised for our internal manufacturing requirements, while the balance is traded in the open market to optimise procurement efficiencies and improve revenue realisation.

risks: Our business is substantially dependent on revenues from the manufacturing of tarpaulin and the trading of granules, and any inability to retain existing customers or attract new customers for these products may adversely affect our business.
Our company is engaged in the manufacturing of tarpaulins and related products.
Additionally, we are involved in the sale of granules, which are used as raw materials in the production of tarpaulins.
While the majority of our operational revenue has historically been derived from manufacturing activities, a notable portion of revenue during the financial year was generated from granule sales.

Reliance on a limited range of products exposes us to substantial risk in the event of adverse changes in market dynamics, including but not limited to shifts in customer preferences or reduced demand.
Such dependency renders our revenue stream susceptible to volatility and market disruptions.
Furthermore, any failure or inability to secure new clientele for these products may adversely affect the Company’s business operations, financial condition, and results of operations.

These arrangements enable us to procure granules at competitive prices, a portion of which is utilised for our internal manufacturing requirements, while the balance is traded in the open market to optimise procurement efficiencies and improve revenue realisation.

capital_history.details: History of Paid-up Equity Share Capital of our Company.
The Company allotted equity shares pursuant to a bonus issue on December 23, 2024, in the ratio of 1:1.
Accordingly, 62,82,000 bonus equity shares were allotted against the then existing 62,82,000 equity shares.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The global tarpaulin market is estimated at USD 6.03 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach USD 9.77 billion by 2036, reflecting a CAGR of 4.96%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Polymers as the Growth Driver Polymers constitute the largest segment of petrochemical consumption, accounting for approximately 65–70% of total demand.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The global polymer products industry is estimated at USD 763.51 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach USD 1,248.30 billion by 2036, reflecting a CAGR of 5.04% over the forecast period.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Similarly, the global plastics and plastic products industry is estimated at USD 643.93 billion in 2026 and is expected to expand to USD 964.02 billion by 2036, registering a CAGR of 4.12% over the forecast period.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: In India, polymer production (including polyethylene, polypropylene, and polyvinyl chloride (PVC)) increased from 71.96 lakh tonnes in FY 2014-15 to 103.47 lakh tonnes in FY 2025-26, registering a CAGR of 3.35%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Polymer imports increased from 53.12 lakh tonnes to 125.29 lakh tonnes during the same period, reflecting a CAGR of 8.13%, while import value grew at a CAGR of 4.74%, indicating an increase in import volumes as well as import expenditure.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Consequently, total polymer supply (domestic production and imports) expanded from 125.08 lakh tonnes in FY 2014-15 to 228.76 lakh tonnes in FY 2025-26, registering a CAGR of 5.65%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Export volumes increased from 15.65 lakh tonnes to 19.25 lakh tonnes over the same period, reflecting a CAGR of 1.90%, while export value grew at a CAGR of 4.74%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Domestic polymer consumption increased from 109.43 lakh tonnes in FY 2014-15 to 209.50 lakh tonnes in FY 2025-26, registering a CAGR of 6.07%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The global shade net market was estimated at USD 1.97 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach USD 3.95 billion by 2036, expanding at a CAGR of 7.23%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The convergence of modern agricultural practices, climate-resilient infrastructure, and urban lifestyle trends is expected to sustain growth in the shade net sector over the medium to long term. 3.4 Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers (FIBCs) The global Flexible Intermediate Bulk Container (FIBC) market was estimated at USD 6.32 billion in 2026, registering a CAGR of 5.9%.
